bio.p1: Hi! I'm Lucas Callamullo, a Backend / Full stack developer based in Córdoba, Argentina.
bio.p2: I've been fascinated by programming logic ever since I started modifying game mods. I probably spend more time than I should coding some idea.
bio.p3: Over the last 3 years, I built my own RoadMap — a self-taught Full-Stack journey focused on building real-world applications from scratch. Alongside that, I'm currently in my fourth year of Systems Engineering at UTN.
bio.p4: Teaching was one of the experiences I enjoyed the most. What I loved about this RoadMap was teaching programming (Algorithms and Paradigms) for university courses over 2 years. It taught me how to break down complex ideas into plain language and introduced me to amazing people who are now friends.
bio.p6: To me, programming is about simplifying life through code — even if replicating life's randomness seems impossible. I love that code is our medium to turn any idea into reality.
